title: Implement noisy clipped-gradient aggregation
prompt: Sum supplied already-clipped per-example gradient tensors, add independent Gaussian noise with coordinate standard deviation sigma*C, and divide by positive supplied denominator. Empty batches still add noise. For Poisson sampling the caller supplies expected-batch normalization; this numerical core does not establish a privacy guarantee or secure randomness.
